names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιος Φλαβιανός», with the rank word left off. The line gives him no epithet; the English epithet here is chosen to keep him apart from the patriarch of the same name whom the same day page also prints.
